notes_source: Hardness 56-60 HRC and 'exceptional toughness / high shock resistance' sourced from Abrams Industries S7 datasheet (https://us.abrams-industries.com/steel/tool-steel/s7). Machinability % not directly published for S7 in sources checked -- 6.5/10 is an ESTIMATE relative to A2 (sourced 70%), verify before citing.

Machinability sourced at 70% of 1%-carbon steel from Hudson Tool Steel A2 datasheet (https://www.hudsontoolsteel.com/technical-data/steelA2). Post-heat-treat hardness (58-62 HRC typical) is an ESTIMATE -- source gave only annealed 235 HBW max; verify hardened HRC before citing.

Hardness 58-60 HRC (balanced wear/toughness temper) and machinability 50-60% of 1%-carbon steel sourced from Hudson Tool Steel D2 datasheet (https://www.hudsontoolsteel.com/technical-data/steelD2). Toughness score is a qualitative synthesis of the same source's description, not a standardized Charpy value.

Machinability 50-60% of 1%-carbon steel and austenitizing temp 1204-1232C sourced from Hudson Tool Steel M2 datasheet (https://www.hudsontoolsteel.com/technical-data/steelM2). Post-heat-treat hardness (60-65 HRC typical) is an ESTIMATE -- source gave only annealed 248 HBW max; verify hardened HRC before citing.

Hardness (~22 HRC), tensile 670 MPa, yield 435 MPa, and impact toughness ~80 J/cm2 (45 ft-lb/in2) sourced from AZoM/ASTM 4130 reference (https://www.astmsteel.com/steel-knowledge/4130-alloy-steel/). Machinability score of 7.0 is an ESTIMATE based on the source's qualitative 'readily machined' description -- no percentage was published there; verify before citing.

Machinability 63% of B1112 sourced from Speedy Metals 4140 datasheet (https://www.speedymetals.com/information/material43.html). Hardness ~32 HRC is CONVERTED from a sourced 311 HB quenched-and-tempered (845C quench / 540C temper) value on TheWorldMaterial (https://www.theworldmaterial.com/astm-sae-aisi-4140-steel/) using a standard HB-to-HRC conversion; treat as approximate.

Hardness HRC 35, tensile 1100 MPa, yield 710 MPa, and machinability 50% (annealed/cold-drawn) sourced from Tech Steel & Materials 4340 datasheet (https://www.techsteel.net/alloy/steel/4340/). Toughness score reflects sourced fracture toughness 53-110 MPa-root-m and 'excellent toughness/fatigue resistance' language from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/4340_steel). Heat treat temp (830C) is an ESTIMATE, not directly sourced this pass -- verify.
